purpose: Catalogo delle fonti storiche verificabili per BTC, ETH, POL/MATIC e Dynamic Top-200. Nessuna fonte è data per scontata: ogni voce richiede probe di copertura prima dell'uso in produzione.

classification_legend.TIER_A: OHLCV giornaliero/intraday completo, provenance verificabile, license compatibile, timestamp UTC coerenti, corporate actions gestibili.
classification_legend.TIER_B: Copertura buona ma con gap minori, metadati parziali, o license da confermare.
classification_legend.TIER_C: Copertura frammentaria, granularità settimanale/mensile, o provenance non completamente riproducibile.
classification_legend.REJECT: Non utilizzabile per replay quantitativo (no provenance, no timestamp, no license).

sources.name: CoinGecko Historical OHLCV (public endpoints + archive)

TOP200_DAILY.note: Prima del 2019 la copertura top-200 giornaliera è incompleta

sources.license: requires commercial license for bulk redistribution; free tier for research
sources.survivorship_handling: delisted assets retained in /coins/{id}/history with status=delisted
sources.corporate_actions: partial (renames tracked, migrations require manual mapping)
risks: no native OHLCV before 2017 for many alts

sources.name: CoinMarketCap Historical Snapshots (via Internet Archive + official API)

TOP200_DAILY.note: Snapshot giornaliero ricostruibile via Wayback Machine con parsing

sources.license: CMC API requires paid plan; Wayback Machine data is public but parsing-intensive

sources.name: Bitcoin Historical Data (Kaggle, multiple datasets)

BTC.note: pre-2013 data has low liquidity and exchange concentration

sources.provenance: must be verified per dataset; prefer MtGox+Bitstamp+Coinbase cross-validated

sources.name: CryptoDataDownload (public exchange archives)
sources.license: free for non-commercial; commercial requires check
sources.provenance: direct exchange CSV exports (Bitstamp, Coinbase, Kraken, Binance)

sources.name: Binance Data Vision (public kline/trades archive)
risks: Binance-only bias pre-2020 for many alts

sources.name: Dune Analytics (on-chain + DEX aggregated)
sources.license: free tier + paid; query results reusable with attribution
risks: not suitable for full top-200 OHLCV

sources.name: Hugging Face crypto datasets
risks: provenance must be verified per dataset

probes_required_before_production: Verify CoinGecko daily top-200 coverage completeness 2019-01 to 2026-09
Quantify Wayback Machine CMC snapshot density per month 2014-2018
Confirm POL/MATIC identity mapping dates across sources
